decision_needed.question: The General Fund paid 50,000 of ARPA money to Colonial Haven, printed as 'Transfer - ARPA Funds - Colonial Haven' under Other Financing Sources (Uses); Colonial Haven is not a village fund and the Statement of Activities counts the 50,000 in governmental cash disbursements (856,167 vs 806,167). Should it be a transfer, other financing use, or spending?
decision_needed.recorded_as: other_financing -50,000 (as printed under Other Financing Sources (Uses); same treatment as FY2023's Colonial Haven bond proceeds transfer)

notes: Cash-basis village; one governmental fund (General, with Street, Library Accounts, Cemetery and Keno sub-accounts on the combining schedule p8). The governmental fund statement rolls forward fund balance (543,875 -> 370,563), recorded as beginning/ending_fund_balance; cash fields left null as in FY2023/FY2024. Reconciles: 543,875 + 682,855 - 806,167 - 50,000 = 370,563. Business-type (Water, Sewer, Ambulance) from the proprietary statement Total column p6 (cash basis); no single printed receipts total (operating 317,915 + interest 3,725 + federal grant 1,152 = 322,792); disbursements total 451,343 printed on the Statement of Activities p2 (operating 312,361 + bond principal 120,000 + bond interest 18,982). Business reconciles: 356,492 + 322,792 - 451,343 = 227,941. Detail: combining schedule p8 recorded per sub-fund column; the General Fund budget-and-actual schedule p7 (same fund, totals of all sub-accounts) omitted to avoid double counting. Business-type funds have no supplementary schedule, so no business-type detail. Read pages 1-8 of 8
